title: Gold 검증 구간 bounded Parquet loading
objective: 2016 Gold audit 및 QVEF materialization이 검증 구간과 계산상 필요한 과거 partition만 읽도록 하되 기존 PIT 결과와 exclusion reason을 동일하게 보존한다.
assumptions: UniversePolicy 기본 liquidity_window_sessions=60은 daily_market의 최장 과거 요구량이며, Gold의 60-session warmup 검증과 함께 validation_start 이전 정확히 max(60, liquidity_window_sessions) sessions를 포함한다.
security_master와 financial_facts는 validation_end 이전에 유효할 수 있는 모든 row를 읽어 PIT valid_from/available_at 판정을 보존한다. 이는 full dataset보다 작지만 임의의 lookback 절단이 아니다.
calendar는 session 경계 계산을 위해 전체를 읽되 row 수 3,001로 대용량 병목 대상이 아니다.

changes.name: GoldWindowInputs
changes.signature: @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) class GoldWindowInputs: calendar: SessionCalendar; security_master: pl.DataFrame; daily_market: pl.DataFrame; financial_facts: pl.DataFrame; corporate_actions: pl.DataFrame; investor_flow: pl.DataFrame

changes.name: load_gold_window_inputs
changes.signature: def load_gold_window_inputs(*, silver_root: Path, validation_start: date, validation_end: date, decision_time: datetime, universe_policy: UniversePolicy | None = None, qvef_policy: QvefFeaturePolicy | None = None) -> GoldWindowInputs

changes.name: load_gold_window_inputs
changes.signature: def load_gold_window_inputs(*, silver_root: Path, validation_start: date, validation_end: date, decision_time: datetime, universe_policy: UniversePolicy | None = None, qvef_policy: QvefFeaturePolicy | None = None) -> GoldWindowInputs

requirements: load_gold_window_inputs must select each Silver dataset through load_latest_silver_table/validated manifests, never directory-name ordering.

daily_market and investor_flow must use ParquetDatasetStore.read_bounded or scan_bounded with projected columns and a start derived from actual calendar sessions: the earliest of max(WARMUP_SESSIONS, universe_policy.liquidity_window_sessions, 20) sessions before validation_start, through validation_end. The validation dates themselves must never be shortened.

security_master and financial_facts must be read from their manifest coverage start through validation_end/decision_time respectively, projected to columns used by Gold, universe, and QVEF. Filter only after manifest and selected-partition digest validation.
corporate_actions must be fully loaded when its dataset is small; if partitioned and time-indexed, it may be bounded only when all actions affecting the candidate interval remain included.
If a required column, partition, manifest, or selected digest is absent/invalid, raise PITDataError; no empty-table substitution is permitted except the already optional investor_flow path.

The bounded loader output must be semantically equivalent to full validated loading followed by the same column projection and temporal predicate: identical GoldAuditManifest hash, eligible universe decisions, feature rows, and exclusion reasons for a deterministic fixture.
No arbitrary timeout, row cap, or reduced validation range may be introduced.

design_rationale.alternatives_considered: The current CLI full-load path was rejected because it materializes 5.8M daily-market and 6.0M security-master rows before filtering. Filtering after full read was rejected because it retains the memory/I/O bottleneck. Restricting the start date to only the validation window was rejected because it breaks warmup and liquidity history.
design_rationale.chosen_reason: Derive the exact history boundary from the certified calendar and policy lookbacks, then use existing manifest-verified bounded Parquet reads with projection. Reference tables whose PIT semantics require all prior validity records use manifest coverage start rather than a heuristic date.
failure_modes: The first validation sessions lose warmup or liquidity history
A partition outside the requested date range is scanned
A prior master/fact record needed for PIT eligibility is omitted
An invalid manifest or missing projected column silently becomes an empty frame

performance_budget.expected_data_scale: current full load: daily_market 5,812,360 rows and security_master 6,002,526 rows; 2016 Gold needs validation year plus 60-session warmup for daily/flow and prior-valid rows for master/facts
performance_budget.storage_format: manifest-verified Hive Parquet with Polars lazy scans
performance_budget.chunking_strategy: monthly partition pruning plus column projection; one final collect per required table
performance_budget.acceleration_candidate: Polars lazy execution is sufficient; no compiled loop is needed

scenarios.expected_behavior: Only warmup-plus-validation daily partitions are requested, not later months.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_load_gold_window_inputs_reads_only_required_daily_partitions(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
    from src.data.gold_loader import load_gold_window_inputs
    from src.storage.parquet_datasets import ParquetDatasetStore

    seen = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(ParquetDatasetStore, 'read_bounded', lambda self, dataset_id, *_args, **kwargs: seen.append((dataset_id, kwargs['session_start'], kwargs['session_end'])) or __import__('polars').DataFrame())
    monkeypatch.setattr('src.data.gold_loader.load_latest_silver_table', lambda **_kwargs: __import__('polars').DataFrame({'session': [datetime(2015, 10, 1, tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2016, 1, 4, tzinfo=UTC)]}) if _kwargs['table'].value == 'calendar' else __import__('polars').DataFrame())

    try:
        load_gold_window_inputs(silver_root=tmp_path, validation_start=date(2016, 1, 4), validation_end=date(2016, 1, 4), decision_time=datetime(2016, 12, 30, tzinfo=UTC))
    except Exception:
        pass
    assert all(end <= date(2016, 1, 4) for _dataset, _start, end in seen)

scenarios.expected_behavior: A bounded read validation failure is surfaced as PITDataError rather than converted to an empty table.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_load_gold_window_inputs_fails_closed_for_missing_projected_column(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, date, datetime
    import pytest
    from src.data.gold_loader import load_gold_window_inputs
    from src.data.schemas import PITDataError

    monkeypatch.setattr('src.data.gold_loader.load_latest_silver_table', lambda **_kwargs: __import__('polars').DataFrame({'session': [datetime(2016, 1, 4, tzinfo=UTC)]}))
    with pytest.raises(PITDataError, match='invalid certified Silver table'):
        load_gold_window_inputs(silver_root=tmp_path, validation_start=date(2016, 1, 4), validation_end=date(2016, 1, 4), decision_time=datetime(2016, 12, 30, tzinfo=UTC))

scenarios.expected_behavior: Bounded inputs yield the same audit manifest hash and eligible IDs as full validated fixture inputs.
